name: Mumbai
note: Navi Mumbai began domestic flights on 25 December 2025 and international flights on 15 July 2026. From those months DGCA's plain MUMBAI does not say which airport. DGCA's 2026 domestic files name Mumbai (Mumbai) and Mumbai (Navi Mumbai) separately.

name: Goa
note: Mopa began commercial flights on 5 January 2023. From that month DGCA's plain GOA does not say which airport. DGCA names DABOLIM and MOPA, GOA separately in some months, and both Goa airports from 2026.
